info.name: M40 - Alerts + Digests + Owner Live Views
info.description:
Canonical M40 collection. Covers alert channels, alert rules, test alert dispatch, alert deliveries (list + retry), digest schedules (CRUD + run), and the real-time owner live feed. Owner SaaS billing payment-failure alerts are LIVE; public diner mobile-money payment-execution alerts are explicitly excluded (gated on a future mobile-money milestone).

See folder `00 Read Me` for variable flow and re-import warning.

item.name: README — variables, run order, re-import warning

request.description:
⚠️ **Re-import required after any script change.** Postman caches pre-request and test scripts at import time. If you previously imported this collection and the scripts have since been updated, delete the collection from Postman and re-import the JSON.

## Cold-session behavior

This collection is **standalone-resilient** (AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R3, R4, R5, R14). The collection-level pre-request script:

1. Auto-logs in `owner@demo.local` / `Owner#123` via `POST /api/auth/login` whenever `accessToken` is missing or shorter than 20 characters (skipped on `/api/auth/login`, `/api/health`, `/api/public/*`).
2. Calls `GET /api/auth/me` whenever the request references `{{orgId}}` or `{{branchId}}` and the variable is empty, then captures `context.defaultOrganizationId` / `context.defaultBranchId` (with `memberships[0]` as fallback).
3. Uses a **Promise chain with `return`** so Postman awaits the auto-login + context resolution **before** firing the main request. (An earlier callback-pyramid version of this script raced the main request and caused 401 on cold sessions.)

Every authenticated request also sets an explicit `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` header — no reliance on collection-level auth inheritance.

## Context-resolution endpoint

**`GET /api/auth/me`** is the canonical endpoint (per R5 / R10 of AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS). It returns `{ context: { defaultOrganizationId, defaultBranchId, ... }, memberships: [...] }`. Do **not** use `/api/me` — that route exists (TenancyController) but returns a different shape and is not the convention used by the stabilized M39 collections.

## Collection variables

| Variable | Set by | Consumed by |
|---|---|---|
| `accessToken`, `refreshToken` | collection-level pre-request via `POST /api/auth/login` (auto-login) or folder A `Login Owner` | every authenticated request (explicit `Authorization` header) |
| `orgId`, `branchId` | collection-level pre-request via `GET /api/auth/me` (or folder A `Get /api/auth/me`) | folders B–G as needed |
| `ruleId`, `ruleCode` | folder B `Create Alert Rule` **or** folder B pre-request (auto-resolved: list-first → create-if-missing) | folder B `Update`, folder D, folder F |
| `channelId`, `channelCode` | folder C `List Alert Channels` (captures seeded `email-owner`) and `Create Alert Channel` | folder C `Update`, folder D |
| `digestId` | folder E `List Digest Schedules` (captures seeded `daily-owner-summary`) and `Create Digest Schedule` | folder E `Update`, `Run` |
| `deliveryId` | folder D `Test Alert (forced failure)` **or** folder F pre-request (auto-resolved: list RETRY_SCHEDULED → dispatch forced-failure) | folder F `Retry Delivery` |
| `sentDeliveryId` | folder D `Test Alert (single channel SENT)` | folder F `Retry already SENT (409)` |

## Folder run order

| # | Folder | Mode |
|---|---|---|
| A | Auth & Context | [STANDALONE] — explicit `Login Owner` + `Get /api/auth/me`. Optional in practice: the collection-level pre-request performs both automatically before any other folder runs. |
| B | Alert Rules | [STANDALONE] — auto-login + auto-context. |
| C | Alert Channels | [STANDALONE] — auto-login + auto-context. |
| D | Test Alerts | [STANDALONE] — uses seeded `email-owner` / `sms-manager` / `slack-ops` channels. |
| E | Digest Schedules | [STANDALONE] — uses seeded `daily-owner-summary`. |
| F | Alert Deliveries / Retry | [STANDALONE] — folder pre-request auto-resolves `deliveryId` via list-first (finds a `RETRY_SCHEDULED` delivery) or creates a fresh forced-failure test alert if none exists. `sentDeliveryId` is **not** auto-resolved (the 409 test skips gracefully if missing). `List Recent Deliveries` is always standalone. |
| G | Owner Live View | [STANDALONE] — auto-login + auto-context. |

## Locked rules verified by this collection

* Owner SaaS billing payment-failure alerts are **live** (folder B has a `BILLING_PAYMENT_FAILURE` rule).
* Public diner mobile-money payment-execution alerts are **NOT** wired — verified in folder G via `notes.publicDinerPaymentExecution` containing `pending`.
* No hotel / property-group milestone exists.

// Canonical shape from auth.service.me(): { context: { defaultOrganizationId, defaultBranchId }, memberships: [...] }
if (!orgId && Array.isArray(b && b.memberships) && b.memberships[0]) orgId = b.memberships[0].organizationId;
if (!branchId && Array.isArray(b && b.memberships) && b.memberships[0]) branchId = b.memberships[0].branchId;
// Dual-scope write per M39 stabilization fix — prevents an empty environment variable from shadowing the collection scope.

request.description: Canonical context-resolution endpoint per AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R5 / R10. Returns `{ context: { defaultOrganizationId, defaultBranchId }, memberships: [...] }` from `auth.service.me()`. The collection-level pre-request also calls this automatically whenever a downstream request references `{{orgId}}` or `{{branchId}}` and the variable is missing — so this folder can be skipped when you only want to run B–G standalone.

exec: // ── Folder B pre-request: R17 upstream entity resolution for ruleId ──
// If ruleId already set (from 'Create Alert Rule' test script or prior run), skip.
// Strategy: 1) list /api/alerts/rules → capture first row  2) create-if-missing
// Makes 'Update Alert Rule (disable)' standalone-resilient — AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R17, R18.
if (ev !== undefined && ev !== null && ev !== '') return ev;
if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return;
if (!tok) { console.log('[folder B prereq] no accessToken — skipping ruleId auto-resolve'); return; }
console.log('[folder B prereq] ruleId resolved via list:', arr[0].id);
} catch(e) { console.log('[folder B prereq] list parse error:', e && e.message); }
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ code: code, name: 'Auto-resolve (standalone)', type: 'LOW_STOCK', severity: 'WARNING', channelCodes: ['email-owner'], thresholdConfig: { minQty: 5 } }) } },
if (b.id) { setVar('ruleId', b.id); setVar('ruleCode', b.code); console.log('[folder B prereq] ruleId created:', b.id); return resolve(true); }
} catch(e) { console.log('[folder B prereq] create error:', e && e.message); }
.catch(function(e) { console.log('[folder B prereq] chain error:', e && e.message); });
// ── Folder F pre-request: R17 upstream entity resolution for deliveryId ──
// If deliveryId already set (from folder D 'Test Alert — forced failure'), skip.
// Strategy: 1) list deliveries → find first RETRY_SCHEDULED  2) dispatch forced-failure test
// Makes 'Retry Delivery (RETRY_SCHEDULED → SENT)' standalone-resilient — AI_POSTMAN_WORKING_PATTERNS R17, R18.
if (ev !== undefined && ev !== null && ev !== '') return ev;
if (v === undefined || v === null || v === '') return;
if (!tok) { console.log('[folder F prereq] no accessToken — skipping deliveryId auto-resolve'); return; }
console.log('[folder F prereq] deliveryId resolved via list:', retryable.id);
} catch(e) { console.log('[folder F prereq] list parse error:', e && e.message); }
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ channelCodes: ['slack-ops'], forceFailure: true }) } },
if (d && d.id) { setVar('deliveryId', d.id); console.log('[folder F prereq] deliveryId from forced-failure dispatch:', d.id); return resolve(true); }
} catch(e) { console.log('[folder F prereq] dispatch error:', e && e.message); }
.catch(function(e) { console.log('[folder F prereq] chain error:', e && e.message); });
console.warn('[skip] no deliveryId — run folder D "Test Alert — forced failure" first');
pm.test('public diner payment execution still pending (locked rule)', () => pm.expect(String(b.notes?.publicDinerPaymentExecution || '')).to.match(/pending/i));
